text.card: A red giant 3,624 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.88 solar masses and 12.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,412 K at its surface.
